title: Provably Efficient Q-learning for Robust Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms based on Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are vulnerable to sim-to-real gaps. To address this issue, distributionally robust RL algorithms based on robust MDPs (RMDPs) have been proposed, for ensuring that agents can perform reliably to unpredictable conditions in real-world environments. Despite of the rich literature, \revision{an efficient model-free method is still lacking} for robust RL, particularly for Markovian data, which is more relevant in practical applications. In this work, we take a step towards settling this problem by proposing a sample efficient (asynchronous Q-learning) algorithm for robust RL. In particular, consider a $\gamma$-discounted infinite-horizon RMDP with state space $\mathcal{S}$ and action space $\mathcal{A}$, where the uncertainty set is specified by the total variation (TV) distance with uncertainty level $\sigma$. translated_title: 面向鲁棒强化学习的可证明高效Q-learning算法
translated_abstract: 基于马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的标准强化学习（RL）算法容易受到模拟到现实差距的影响。为解决这一问题，研究者提出了基于鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）的分布式鲁棒强化学习算法，以确保智能体在现实环境中的不可预测条件下仍能可靠地执行任务。尽管相关文献十分丰富，鲁棒强化学习仍然缺乏高效的无模型方法，尤其是针对马尔可夫数据的方法，而后者在实际应用中更为常见。在这项工作中，我们通过提出一种样本高效的（异步Q-learning）鲁棒强化学习算法，朝着解决这一问题迈出了一步。特别地，我们考虑一个具有状态空间 $\mathcal{S}$ 和动作空间 $\mathcal{A}$ 的 $\gamma$ 折扣无限时域RMDP，其中不确定性集由总变差距离刻画，不确定性水平为 $\sigma$。在假设能够获得单条轨迹（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向鲁棒强化学习的样本高效异步Q-learning算法，填补了无模型鲁棒RL方法（尤其是针对马尔可夫数据场景）的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first sample-efficient asynchronous Q-learning algorithm for robust reinforcement learning, filling the gap of efficient model-free methods for robust RL, particularly with Markovian data.
